title: View Team Builder Profile Details
story: As an admin, I want to open a Team Builder's profile to view their personal details, company profile, and account information so that I can review their account thoroughly when needed.
ac: - Clicking a Team Builder row opens their profile - Profile shows: name, email, company name, company profile, account creation date, subscription plan, and status - Read-only view with action buttons (Suspend, Delete)

title: View Team Builder Role History
story: As an admin, I want to view all roles created by a Team Builder so that I can audit their hiring activity and identify any policy violations.
ac: - Role History tab shows all roles created by this Team Builder - Each row shows: title, type, status, date posted, and applicant count - Clicking a role navigates to the role detail view

title: View Team Builder Hiring Activity
story: As an admin, I want to view a Team Builder's hiring activity including trials started, offers sent, and full-time and part-time hires made so that I can understand how actively they are using the platform.
ac: - Hiring Activity tab shows: total trials started, total offers sent, total full-time and part-time hires, and trial-to-hire conversion rate - Individual contract records listed with Independent Contractor name, role, type, and status

title: View Team Builder Evaluation History
story: As an admin, I want to view all evaluations a Team Builder has submitted for Independent Contractors so that I can monitor the quality and fairness of their assessments.
ac: - Evaluation History tab shows all evaluations submitted by this Team Builder - Each entry shows: Independent Contractor name, date, star rating, and written feedback - Read-only view

title: View Team Builder Dispute History
story: As an admin, I want to view all disputes filed by or against a Team Builder so that I can assess their dispute track record when resolving issues.
ac: - Dispute History tab shows all disputes filed by or against this Team Builder - Each row shows: date, opposing party, amount, reason, and status - Clicking a dispute navigates to dispute detail

title: View Team Builder Payment History
story: As an admin, I want to view all payment transactions associated with a Team Builder so that I can audit their financial activity on the platform.
ac: - Payment History tab shows all financial transactions associated with this Team Builder - Each row shows: date, type, amount, and status - Read-only view

title: Suspend / Reactivate Team Builder
story: As an admin, I want to suspend or reactivate a Team Builder account so that I can enforce platform policies and restore access when appropriate.
ac: - Suspend button changes account status to Suspended - Suspended account cannot log in or use the platform - Reactivate button restores Active status - Team Builder notified of both actions - Confirmation prompt shown before both actions

title: Delete Team Builder
story: As an admin, I want to permanently delete a Team Builder account so that I can remove accounts that violate platform terms or are no longer needed.
ac: - Delete button permanently removes the Team Builder account and all associated data - Cannot be undone - Double confirmation prompt shown - Team Builder notified of deletion

title: View All Independents
story: As an admin, I want to see a table of all Independent Contractor accounts on the platform showing name, email, status, and date joined so that I can manage and monitor all Independent Contractor accounts in one place.
ac: - Independents table shows: name, email, role, status, date joined, and total contracts - Default sort by most recent - Pagination applied

title: Search Independents
story: As an admin, I want to search Independent Contractors by name or email so that I can quickly locate a specific account.
ac: - Search by name or email - Results update dynamically - Empty state shown when no results match

title: Filter Independents by Status
story: As an admin, I want to filter Independent Contractors by status (Active, Suspended, Inactive, Pending Verification) so that I can focus on specific groups that need attention.
ac: - Filter options: Active, Suspended, Inactive, Pending Verification - Filter applies immediately - Active filter visually indicated

title: View / Update Independent Status
story: As an admin, I want to view and update the status of an Independent Contractor account directly from the table so that I can quickly act on accounts that require status changes.
ac: - Status badge visible on each table row - Admin can update status directly from table or profile - Status change triggers notification to user - Confirmation prompt shown

title: View Independent Profile Details
story: As an admin, I want to open an Independent Contractor's profile to view their personal details, skills, work style badges, and account information so that I can review their account thoroughly.
ac: - Clicking an Independent Contractor row opens their profile - Profile shows: photo, name, email, role, rate, experience level, workplace tags, skills, account creation date, and status - Action buttons available: Suspend, Delete

title: View Independent Contract History
story: As an admin, I want to view all contracts an Independent Contractor has been part of including trial, full-time and part-time engagements so that I can audit their work history on the platform.
ac: - Contract History tab shows all contracts (Trial, Full-Time and Part-Time) the Independent Contractor has been part of - Each row shows: company name, role, type, status, start date, and end date - Clicking a contract shows contract details

title: View Independent Performance Data
story: As an admin, I want to view a full log of an Independent Contractor's performance data including task records, TFP scores, evaluation results, and activity logs so that I can store and analyze performance data for future platform improvements.
ac: - Performance Data tab stores and displays: all task records (title, status, due date, who added it, and approval history), TFP score history (all phases), evaluation results, and recent activity logs - Data is stored for internal use and future insights - Not publicly displayed to Team Builders or Independent Contractors - Admin can view all historical performance data per Independent Contractor

title: View Independent Dispute History
story: As an admin, I want to view all disputes filed by or against an Independent Contractor so that I can assess their dispute track record when resolving issues.
ac: - Dispute History tab shows all disputes filed by or against this Independent Contractor - Each row shows: date, opposing party, amount, reason, and status - Read-only view

title: View Independent Payment History
story: As an admin, I want to view all payment transactions associated with an Independent Contractor so that I can audit their earnings activity.
ac: - Payment History tab shows all payment transactions for this Independent Contractor: received payments and pending amounts - Each row shows: date, type, amount, and status

title: Suspend / Reactivate Independent
story: As an admin, I want to suspend or reactivate an Independent Contractor account so that I can enforce platform policies and restore access when appropriate.
ac: - Suspend changes account to Suspended — Independent Contractor cannot log in or use platform - Reactivate restores Active status - User notified of both actions - Confirmation prompt shown

title: Delete Independent
story: As an admin, I want to permanently delete an Independent Contractor account so that I can remove accounts that violate platform terms or are no longer needed.
ac: - Delete permanently removes the Independent Contractor account and all data - Cannot be undone - Double confirmation prompt shown - User notified of deletion

title: View All Roles
story: As an admin, I want to see a table of all roles on the platform showing title, Team Builder, type, status, and date posted so that I can monitor all listings in one place.
ac: - Roles table shows: title, Team Builder name, type (Full-Time/Trial/Part-Time), status (Active/Closed/Draft/Flagged), date posted, and applicant count - Default sort by most recent - Pagination applied

title: Search & Filter Roles
story: As an admin, I want to search and filter roles by title, type, and status so that I can quickly find specific listings that need review or action.
ac: - Search by role title or Team Builder name - Filter by type (Full-Time/Trial/Part-Time), status (Active/Closed/Draft/Flagged) - Filters can be combined - Results update dynamically

title: View Role Details
story: As an admin, I want to open a specific role to view its full details so that I can review the content and assess whether it meets platform guidelines.
ac: - Clicking a role row opens full details - Shows all fields: title, description, requirements, budget/salary, duration, trial tasks (if trial), hours per week (if part-time) - Approve and Flag action buttons available

title: Approve / Flag Role
story: As an admin, I want to approve or flag a role so that I can ensure only appropriate and policy-compliant listings are visible to Independent Contractors on the platform.
ac: - Approve button marks role as approved and visible to Independent Contractors - Flag button marks role for policy violation review and hides it from Independent Contractors - Flagged roles are visually differentiated in the table - Team Builder notified when their role is flagged

title: Remove Role
story: As an admin, I want to remove a role that violates platform policies so that I can maintain the quality and safety of the platform.
ac: - Remove button permanently removes the role from the platform - Confirmation prompt shown - Team Builder notified of removal - Cannot be undone

title: View Active Contract Payments
story: As an admin, I want to see all active contract payments currently held by PayMongo so that I can monitor the total amount held across all active contracts.
ac: - Active Contract Payments table shows all contracts with funds currently held by PayMongo - Each row shows: contract ID, Team Builder name, Independent Contractor name, amount held, and hold start date - Total amount held by PayMongo shown as a summary card at top

title: View All Disputes
story: As an admin, I want to see a table of all disputes filed on the platform showing the parties involved, amount in question, and current status so that I can prioritize and manage dispute resolution.
ac: - Disputes table shows all disputes with: date filed, filing party, opposing party, amount in question, who the case is waiting on (with the time left on a party's turn), age, reason and status (Pending/Resolved/Rejected/Withdrawn) - Filter by status and reason, and search by party, contract or reason - Cards count the cases waiting on support, those past the 5-day review target, those awaiting release and the amount held in escrow - New activity on a case is flagged until it's opened; default sort by most recent

title: View Dispute Details
story: As an admin, I want to open a specific dispute to view its full details including the reason, supporting evidence, and timeline so that I can make an informed process compliance ruling.
ac: - Clicking a dispute opens the same case both parties see: whose turn it is, where each side stands, the timeline of everything each side and support have done, the files, the settlement on the table and the contract's payments - A process check lists the facts on file — trial ended, evaluation submitted, tasks approved, escrow funded, amount within escrow — with a link to the contract's work (AD-050) - On support's turn, Ask a party puts a question to one side, who then has 5 days to answer; both are told - Resolve and Reject are available while the case is open

title: Resolve Dispute
story: As an admin, I want to resolve a dispute by making a process compliance ruling in favor of either the Team Builder or the Independent Contractor so that I can formally close the case and coordinate the appropriate payment action with PayMongo.
ac: - Admin selects resolution: rule in favor of Team Builder or Independent Contractor - Entering resolution notes is required - Both Team Builder and Independent Contractor are notified of the outcome, and it closes the case on their pages - Dispute status changes to Resolved; an open settlement proposal is closed with it - Triggers the payment action: a refund to the Team Builder moves straight away — from the trial's escrow (never more than it holds), or on a full-time or part-time role from the pay kept back for the case, anything more coming off the next pay; a ruling for the Independent Contractor waits on the payment release (AD-035)

title: Request Payment Release
story: As an admin, I want to request a payment release to the Independent Contractor so that I can coordinate the payment when a dispute is resolved in the Independent Contractor's favor.
ac: - Request Payment Release is available on cases closed in the Independent Contractor's favor — by a ruling, or because the Team Builder's turn ran out - Confirmation prompt shown - Payment release coordinated with PayMongo immediately; it goes on the case timeline and into both ledgers - Both parties notified - On a full-time or part-time role the release pays out the pay kept back for the case

title: Reverse Payment
story: As an admin, I want to reverse a payment that was incorrectly processed so that I can correct financial errors and protect both parties on the platform.
ac: - Reverse Payment button available when a payment needs to be corrected - Reason for reversal required - Confirmation prompt shown - Affected parties notified - Transaction record updated to show reversal

title: View All Subscriptions
story: As an admin, I want to see a table of all active and inactive subscriptions on the platform so that I can monitor subscription activity and revenue.
ac: - Subscriptions table shows: user name, plan name, billing cycle, status (Active/Cancelled/Past Due), renewal date - Filter by status - Default sort by renewal date

title: View Subscription Details
story: As an admin, I want to open a specific subscription record to view the plan details, billing history, and account holder so that I can assist with subscription-related issues.
ac: - Clicking a subscription opens full details: plan features, billing history, payment method on file, and account holder info - Read-only view

title: Update Subscription Plan
story: As an admin, I want to manually update a user's subscription plan so that I can resolve billing issues or apply special arrangements when needed.
ac: - Admin can manually change a user's subscription plan - Reason for change required - Change applies immediately - User notified of the plan update

title: View All Transactions
story: As an admin, I want to see a full list of all financial transactions on the platform so that I can monitor overall payment activity and identify any irregularities.
ac: - Transactions table shows all platform financial activity - Each row shows: date, type, parties involved, amount, status - Filter by type, status, and date range - Default sort by most recent - Pagination applied

title: View Transaction Details
story: As an admin, I want to open a specific transaction to view its full breakdown including amount, parties, date, and status so that I can investigate and audit individual payments.
ac: - Clicking a transaction opens full breakdown: transaction ID, date, amount, parties, payment method, and status - Read-only view

title: Issue Refund
story: As an admin, I want to issue a refund for a specific transaction so that I can resolve payment disputes or correct billing errors on behalf of users.
ac: - Issue Refund available on completed transactions - Reason for refund required - Confirmation prompt shown - Refund processed and both parties notified - Transaction record updated to reflect refund

title: Manage Marketing Banners
story: As an admin, I want to create, edit, and remove marketing banners that appear on both the Team Builder and Independent Contractor dashboards so that I can control platform-wide announcements, promotions, and featured content.
ac: - Admin can create, edit, and remove marketing banners - Banner fields: image/text content, CTA link, target audience (Team Builder / Independent Contractor / Both), active dates - Active banners appear on relevant dashboards immediately - Inactive or expired banners are hidden automatically - Preview available before publishing

title: View Signup & Growth Stats
story: As an admin, I want to view signup and growth statistics including new user registrations over time so that I can track platform growth and identify trends.
ac: - Shows total signups over time with a line/bar chart - Breakdown by user type (Team Builder vs Independent Contractor) - Filter by date range (7 days, 30 days, 90 days, custom) - Growth rate % shown vs previous period

title: View Active Contracts Overview
story: As an admin, I want to see an overview of all active contracts on the platform broken down by type (Trial, Full-Time, Part-Time) so that I can monitor engagement levels and platform utilization.
ac: - Shows total active contracts broken down by type (Trial, Full-Time, Part-Time) - Chart showing contract volume over time - Filter by date range

title: View Trial Conversion Rate
story: As an admin, I want to view the trial conversion rate — how many trials end in a full-time or part-time hire — so that I can measure how effectively the platform is facilitating long-term hires and assess product success.
ac: - Conversion rate shown as % of trials that resulted in a full-time or part-time hire - Trend over time shown as a chart - Filter by date range - Comparison vs platform target (80%) shown

title: View Platform Revenue Summary
story: As an admin, I want to view a summary of platform revenue including subscription income and transaction fees so that I can monitor financial performance and report on business health.
ac: - Revenue summary shows: total subscription revenue, total transaction fees, total refunds issued, net revenue - Breakdown by period (monthly, quarterly, annual) - Filter by date range - Exportable report

title: Manage Admin Accounts
story: As an admin, I want to create, edit, and deactivate admin accounts so that I can control who has access to the admin panel and manage the admin team.
ac: - Admin Accounts table shows all admin users: name, email, role, and status - Admin can create new admin accounts with assigned roles - Admin can deactivate existing admin accounts - Cannot delete own account - Confirmation prompt shown for deactivation

title: View Audit Logs
story: As an admin, I want to view a full audit log of all actions performed by admin accounts so that I can maintain accountability and investigate any unauthorized or suspicious activity.
ac: - Audit Log shows all admin actions with: timestamp, admin name, action type, and affected record - Filter by admin, action type, and date range - Default sort by most recent - Read-only — logs cannot be deleted or edited

title: View a Contract's Work
story: As a Hireable admin, I want to see a contract's work exactly as both parties do so that I can check the task log when reviewing a dispute.
ac: - Opened from a dispute's details (Open the contract's work) and from the live pair's accounts under User management - Shows the same workspace as the Team Builder and Independent Contractor — every view, the search and filters, each item's panel with its full activity — under Disputes in the navigation - Read-only: no Add task, nothing draggable, no editable fields, no comments; the page says so - Read-only is enforced on every save, not only in the interface: a change attempted any other way is refused and nothing is saved - A contract that no longer exists says so

title: Dispute Deadlines
story: As a Hireable admin, I want response deadlines on disputes to enforce themselves, and to be able to extend one, so that cases keep moving without support chasing anyone.
ac: - Each party's turn on a case has a 5-day deadline, shown to both parties and to support - A reminder is sent to the party on the clock when one day is left - When a turn runs out, the case closes in the other side's favor on its own — whichever portal is open when it happens — goes on the timeline, and both sides are told - Support can extend the deadline of whoever is on the clock by 1 to 5 days, before it runs out and never after; both sides are told the new deadline - Disputes filed before cases had turns wait on support rather than on a party, so nobody loses one by default under a rule it wasn't filed under
